signals.usability_note: Clear daytime view of a single-family Cape Cod-style home with a large front lawn, set back from the street.
signals.notes: The home appears recently updated, with fresh gray siding, white trim, a white porch railing, new-looking foundation plantings with mulch beds and white vinyl fencing, and a long asphalt driveway leads to an attached garage; vehicles visible in the frame are on neighboring properties.
